Candidate 2 area already slightly exceeds baseline, so electrical closure alone cannot establish an improvement. Baseline remains the only qualified incumbent: cell area 161954 um2, setup/hold +0.19292/+0.114491 ns, Q=1. Retain all failures and costs and the best qualified result. Frozen period is 10526 ps. Energy scope remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, without SDF/glitch or silicon-power claims.
